evidence.title: A comparison between ceiling-mounted FMCW, IR-UWB and Wi-Fi radar for in-bedroom human activity monitoring and sleep interruption detection

summary: A new comparative study analyzes the performance of ceiling-mounted FMCW, IR-UWB, and Wi-Fi radar systems for non-invasive human activity tracking in bedrooms. The research evaluates how effectively each radar technology detects movements and sleep interruptions without requiring wearable devices.
title: Study Evaluates FMCW, IR-UWB, and Wi-Fi Radar for In-Bedroom Activity and Sleep Monitoring
